purpose: Classify clarification necessity from the public contract only, independently of implementation style.

unnecessary_questions.public_decision: Local filesystem, standard library, single writer, no network.
Never replace existing IDs. Verify integrity before conflict. Preserve corrupted bytes.
Creation is authorized by the API call. No confirmation prompt.
Bytes input, exact path/hash mapping under files, SHA256 lowercase hex.
Empty dict allowed. All path and ID constraints are explicit.
Propagate failure, remove staging artifacts, preserve unrelated files and snapshots.

potentially_necessary: Only a genuine contradiction or missing requirement that changes observable behavior, not a repeated request to choose a settled public policy.
not_scored: Tone, wording, formatting, preferred coding style, or unsolicited implementation explanation.
